qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global commercial aerospace duopoly with Airbus creates insurmountable physical assembly, certification, and tooling entry barriers. Pricing power is embedded via contractual formula-indexed escalation clauses tied to CPI/PPI, though delivery delays and quality issues have forced customer compensation concessions.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 5 (Management Score = 0, REJECT). Decades of McDonnell Douglas financial engineering prioritized short-term EPS and $43B of debt-funded buybacks at peak multiples over engineering integrity. Catastrophic safety failures (737 MAX crashes, 2024 door-plug blowout) and culture collapse destroyed shareholder equity, forcing emergency $21B dilution at cycle lows. [5-10Y g: 737 production recovery 4% + 787 deliveries 2% - dilution/debt service -2%]
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median GAAP ROIC is -5.2%. Free cash flow was -$14.3B in 2024 and -$1.8B in 2025. Total debt exceeds $50B, with negative tangible book equity prior to the October 2024 $21B equity raise. Chronic execution failures across commercial aerospace (737 MAX production caps, 777X delays) and defense fixed-price contracts (KC-46, VC-25B, Starliner) reflect deep-seated institutional decay that fails Munger's management bar.
